statusNote: P0-P4 and the P5 engineering backlog are complete. The 2026-08-27 closeout implements hook-driven backpressure and dead-owner takeover, full local/hosted parity planning and proof reuse, weighted admission with RSS telemetry, cache warming and first-touch evidence, ignored local portfolio projections, contention-family serialization, goals-only required-check skips, and the live stacked-PR and merge-queue evaluations. The initiative remains active because its representative post-merge observation week cannot begin until the final implementation PR lands; research/metrics-closeout.md owns that explicit gate.
mission: Agents ship correct code faster: sub-minute failure backpressure into the owning session, local verify that near-guarantees the 17 required remote checks, readable+warm Turbo cache in every checkout, memory-aware concurrent verify/publish, and no derived-file merge treadmill.

provenance.note: Successor surface for speed-loop/repo-quality-throughput/quality-speedup threads plus the 2026-08-13 nine-lane fan-out (codex Sol + grok 4.6) and ADHD backpressure divergence; carries the open monitor/parity/cache/concurrency/hot-file items those retained packets parked.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until a representative week shows: backpressure p95 under 60s to an attached session (under 5 minutes with takeover), the parity ledger records zero recurring locally-catchable required-check failures, every sibling checkout reads the remote cache, at least two concurrent verifies run under admission without OOM, hot-file conflicts no longer force PR rework, and the final PR is driven to mergeable via yeet.

stopConditions: Any backpressure enforcement (hook deny, Stop veto, poison-pill) deadlocks a session or checkout - severity gates and waives must ship with the enforcement, never after.
Admission/auto-heal/takeover would mutate state it cannot attribute (foreign lease, malformed lock, baseline regeneration) - fail loud and stop.
PR remote-cache reads (C2), the INDEX end-state change (E2), or path-filtered required checks (E6) proceed without their recorded operator decision note.
A parity change weakens a security lane (gitleaks pinning, OSV, fork isolation) to make local green easier.
